newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's top economic official offers resignation.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's top economic official offers resignation.

text.p: Ecuador's Monetary Board President Danilo Carrera tendered his resignation Tuesday to President Fabian Alarcon over differences in economic policy, a Central Bank source told Reuters.
"The president of the board personally handed his resignation...we're just waiting for the president's orders," the source said.
Alarcon can accept or reject the resignation and a decision was expected shortly. The Monetary Board sets economic policy.
The source said Carrera offered to bow out of the cabinet due to "a difference of opinion with the government over economic policy."
He had been ratified in his post during the country's last cabinet crisis in May and an announcement on new economic measures was expected this week.
